research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Material Innovations
summary: Materials for SS27 kidswear: UPF-rated swim and performance knits, recycled fibres, organic and certified cotton, quick-dry and sand-free fabrics.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- UV filters in swimwear, tees and accessories<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Recycled fibres, organic cotton and certified materials; breathable, quick-dry fabrics<sup>[1]</sup>.
- Sustainable lycra (Piccoli Principi), UPF50+ performance fabrics and sand-free towels (Teeter Totter), recycled fine fabrics with UPF 50+ (Marie Raxevisky)<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Readiness
sections.body:
| Material | Readiness (Forecut assessment) |
|---|---|
| UPF swim and knit | Ready; test and label |
| Recycled polyamide and polyester swim | Ready |
| Organic cotton (certified) | Ready |
| Sand-free microfibre towels | Ready |

design_implications:
- Test UPF to a recognised standard (EN 13758 or AS/NZS 4399).
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Verify every sustainability claim before using it.
